0.comment: Zhongli: Guizhong and the Guili Assembly
0.content: Before Liyue Harbor existed, Morax and Guizhong, the God of Dust, built a settlement of humans and adepti on the Guili Plains, named after them both; the gods there included Marchosius, the God of the Stove. In the Archon War a catastrophic battle laid waste to the Guili Plains and Dihua Marsh, and Guizhong perished. Morax led the survivors south of Mt. Tianheng and founded Liyue Harbor with the adepti about 3,700 years ago. The Guizhong Ballista on Mt. Tianheng and Guizhong's collected treasures preserve her legacy. Zhongli rarely speaks of her directly.

1.comment: Zhongli: The Rite of Descension and the Rite of Parting
1.content: Every year Rex Lapis descended to give Liyue its oracle for the year. At the last Rite of Descension (1.0) his body fell from the sky, apparently assassinated, and the Qixing locked down the harbor; the Traveler was suspected and fled with Childe's help. Childe introduced them to Zhongli, who said it was his duty to give Rex Lapis a proper farewell. Spending Fatui Mora freely, Zhongli and the Traveler gathered Noctilucous Jade, Silk Flower perfumes, the Cleansing Bell from Madame Ping and Glaze Lilies. The body was an "exuvia", a shed form, stored at the Golden House.

2.comment: Zhongli: The Contract to End All Contracts
2.content: Zhongli's last contract as Geo Archon was with the Cryo Archon: he would hand over the Geo Gnosis, which Signora collected peacefully after the Rite of Parting. He had kept it in reserve in case his test failed and Liyue fell into chaos. Even mortals contract on "equivalent exchange", yet what the Tsaritsa wagered to balance the scales has never been revealed. He says no trade is truly worth a Gnosis, and that a clause forbids him to divulge the contract's contents.

3.content: Long ago an evil god learned a young yaksha's weakness and forced him to commit atrocities and devour dreams. Morax freed him and gave him the name Xiao to protect him. Xiao, as Alatus, became one of the five foremost yakshas, who fought the lingering hatred of buried gods; he is the last still fighting, burdened by karmic debt. Zhongli sighs that he is "still fulfilling his duty to this very day" and sends him medicine, warning that Paimon must not eat it. Xiao reveres Rex Lapis absolutely and is puzzled by Zhongli's mortal hobbies ("Birds, antiques, flowers... What deeper meaning do they hold?").

4.content: When Barbatos first came to Liyue, Rex Lapis prepared to help a neighbour in crisis, and Barbatos tossed him a wine bottle: "Here's some wine from Mondstadt. Care for a taste?" He kept visiting with endless questions, and the first Seven began to gather in Liyue. Of that first table, only the two of them still hold their seats. Zhongli can smell when the bard has been nearby ("It reeks of wine"), calls him a drunkard and a disgrace to the arts, and offers to brew sobering tea that takes six hours. He says a friend from Mondstadt always brought Dandelion Wine.

5.content: Azhdaha was a blind Geo dragon from beneath Liyue. Morax answered his wish, brought him above ground, gave him sight and made a contract: he could live among people, but if he ever brought ruin to order he would be sealed in the dark again. Erosion ground away Azhdaha's memories, and mining that shook the Ley Lines drove him mad with pain. A thousand years ago he attacked The Chasm; Morax fought him through the mines and sealed him beneath an ancient tree at Nantianmen. The Dragonfall stone was born in that battle.

6.comment: Zhongli: Zibai, the White Horse Adeptus
6.content: Zibai was an envoy of the Three Moons who ruled Lang-Gan and befriended Morax in a remote age; she first saw him fighting as three identical selves under the battle cry "The Lord of Geo, Heaven's Star!", and he taught her to excise the Three Deadly Selves. When divine punishment fell on her nation she severed her Selves and died, and the avatar of Time preserved her soul's fragments within them. In the 6.3 Lantern Rite story quest A Lanternlit Ode to the Silver Moon (first released with a time-limited event, now a permanent Story Quest), Zhongli explained that the shadowmoon, her prison, was disintegrating now that a new moon had been born, and that the Traveler had brought the Frost Moon back. He asked the Traveler to help reunite her Heavenly, Earthly and Human souls before the festival night.
